components.name: Heritage Hero
components.description: Image-led homepage opening with an atmospheric dark overlay and a clear two-action hierarchy.
components.html:
Awakening Bharat.
Inspiring the future.

A timeless civilization. A new generation of thinkers.

Explore our Sankalpas
components.css: .ds-hero { display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:665px; padding:48px; color:#fff; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0d202ce8 0%,#142430b8 36%,#13253435 77%),linear-gradient(0deg,#142735bd,transparent 40%),url(/images/heritage-hero.webp) center/cover; } .ds-hero-content { max-width:760px; } .ds-hero h1 { margin:0; color:#fff; font:600 clamp(2.5rem,5.25vw,4.75rem)/1.16 var(--font-manrope),sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.055em; } .ds-hero h1 span { color:#ffba78; } .ds-hero p { margin:25px 0 30px; color:#e1e4e3; } .ds-hero-action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:20px; min-height:51px; padding:13px 25px; border:1px solid var(--orange); border-radius:var(--radius); background:var(--orange); color:#142a36; font:800 .8125rem/1.5 var(--font-manrope),sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background .2s,transform .2s,border-color .2s; } .ds-hero-action svg { width:18px; height:18px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; } .ds-hero-action:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:#f58b3d; border-color:#f58b3d; } .ds-hero-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ffcf94; outline-offset:4px; }

components.description: Confident saffron action used for the most important next step.
components.html: <button class="ds-button">Explore our Sankalpas <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M7 17 17 7M7 7h10v10"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:20px; min-height:51px; padding:13px 25px; border:1px solid var(--orange); border-radius:var(--radius); background:var(--orange); color:#142a36; font:800 .8125rem/1.5 var(--font-manrope),sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s,transform .2s,border-color .2s; } .ds-button svg { width:18px; height:18px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#f58b3d; border-color:#f58b3d; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button:disabled { background:#d7d4cb; color:#565b5c; border-color:#d7d4cb; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.css: .ds-button-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:14px; min-height:51px; padding:13px 25px; border:1px solid #ffffff75; border-radius:var(--radius); background:transparent; color:#fff; font:800 .8125rem/1.5 var(--font-manrope),sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background .2s,border-color .2s,transform .2s; } .ds-button-outline svg { width:18px; height:18px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background:#ffffff17; border-color:#fff; } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus-ring-on-dark); outline-offset:4px; }

components.css: .ds-filter { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:9px; } .ds-chip { min-height:44px; padding:9px 18px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--radius); background:transparent; color:var(--ink); font:600 .75rem/1.5 var(--font-manrope),sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed=true] { border-color:var(--ink); background:var(--ink); color:#fff; } .ds-chip:hover:not([aria-pressed=true]) { border-color:#a28a69; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset:3px; }

components.css: .ds-card { padding:30px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--radius); background:var(--surface-card); color:var(--ink); } .ds-eyebrow { display:block; margin-bottom:18px; color:var(--orange-dark); font:800 .75rem/1.6 var(--font-manrope),sans-serif; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-card h3 { margin:0 0 18px; color:var(--ink); font:600 1.375rem/1.25 var(--font-manrope),sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-card p { margin:0 0 22px; color:var(--muted); font:400 .875rem/1.8 var(--font-manrope),sans-serif; } .ds-card a { color:var(--ink); font:800 .875rem/1.7 var(--font-manrope),sans-serif; text-underline-offset:5px; } .ds-card a:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-card a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset:4px; }

components.css: .ds-field label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:var(--ink); font:700 .75rem/1.6 var(--font-manrope),sans-serif; } .ds-field label span { color:var(--orange-dark); } .ds-field input { display:block; width:100%; min-height:45px; padding:12px 13px; border:1px solid var(--control-border); border-radius:var(--radius); background:#fff; color:var(--ink); font:400 1rem/1.6 var(--font-manrope),sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#687379; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset:2px; border-color:var(--focus-ring); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; } .ds-nav a { position:relative; padding:13px 0; color:var(--ink); font:600 .8125rem/1.5 var(--font-manrope),sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a::after { position:absolute; right:0; bottom:5px; left:0; height:2px; background:var(--orange); content:""; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition:transform .2s; } .ds-nav a:hover::after,.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]::after { transform:scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { color:var(--orange-dark); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview:
Indic Thought Forum's visual language makes heritage feel active and open to inquiry, rather than frozen as display. Warm paper surfaces, blue-charcoal typography, saffron actions, and the site's cultural imagery frame a contemporary space for learning, dialogue, and purposeful participation.

The system should help a broad, young audience learn and understand. Use serious, knowledge-led hierarchy, and present data clearly when the content calls for it; visualization should explain real information, not decorate the page or imply unsupported impact. Controls are clear and confident, while cards remain quiet and well structured.
keyCharacteristics: Living heritage expressed through contemporary content and real community imagery.
Warm neutrals, a focused saffron accent, and deep navy anchors.
Clear, serious information hierarchy with purposeful calls to action.
Quiet, lightly bordered surfaces with restrained ambient depth.

rules.name: The Action Accent Rule
rules.body: Use bright saffron for primary actions and short signals; use the deeper accent for supporting text and icon details. Let neutral text and surfaces carry the reading experience.

rules.name: The One Sans Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep Manrope as the display and body workhorse. Use serif type only for the existing brand and editorial accents, never for long-form body copy.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows separate floating or interactive elements from their surroundings; do not use heavy elevation as the default card hierarchy.

dos: Do preserve the official logo, heritage artwork, and actual community photography.
Do use the established Manrope hierarchy, warm neutral surfaces, saffron action accent, and deep navy anchors.
Do keep data displays serious and legible, with clear labels, units, and context; use only confirmed information.
Do maintain readable text, visible focus, and clear state distinctions across light and dark surfaces.
Do use generous container alignment and reflow layouts instead of introducing horizontal overflow.
donts: Don't introduce a new color family, display typeface, or competing visual identity without an explicit redesign decision.
Don't replace the heritage hero with a gradient-only banner or add decorative data charts without real information to explain.
Don't use heavy shadows, pill-shaped cards, or ornamental borders as a default treatment.
Don't invent metrics, endorsements, event details, or outcomes to make the site appear more authoritative.
